Every number, and the run that produced it.

This page is generated from docs/proof/claims.toml and the evidence files it points at. It is not written by hand. The same generator runs in the project's health check, so a number that drifts from its evidence fails the build rather than reaching a reader.

Two claims are deliberately unpublished and say so in the ledger, and several are marked read by a human: they are historical or rounded statements that no automatic check can settle, and pretending otherwise would be a false green.
